summary: HomeMaid AB (publ) provides cleaning services in Sweden. It offers home, general, moving, window, display, and office cleaning services. The company also provides deep cleaning, pets, holiday service, washing and ironing, floor care, polishing of metal objects and crystal, carpet cleaning, oven cleaning, fridge and freezer cleaning, cutlery boxes, balcony cleaning, after renovation cleaning, and bed cleaning. It is also involved in assistance as a salary benefit services. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Halmstad, Sweden.
